## PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE
15-layer AI platform execution flow documented on portfolio homepage:
User Intent → Agent Orchestration → Memory & Context → Tool/MCP → Model Router →
Adaptive AI Governance → Inference → Evaluation → Guardrails → Observability →
Drift Monitor → FinOps → Audit Trail → Human Approval → Business Outcome

- /demos/multi-agent           — Analyzer → Researcher → Strategist with a human review step

- /demos/edge-agent-collaboration — Browser PII redaction + human approval + cloud summary

- /demos/generative-ui         — Catalog-constrained, server-validated generative UI

## PROFILE QUERY ENDPOINT (callable by AI agents)
Endpoint:   POST https://www.prasadkavuri.com/api/mcp-demo
Protocol:   JSON { "query": "..." } — LLM tool calling over JSON-Schema tools (not an MCP JSON-RPC server); no auth required, rate limited
Tools available:
  get_experience(company)              — work history by company
  search_skills(category)             — skills by category (ai_ml, cloud_infrastructure, leadership, industry, core)
  get_achievements(company?)          — quantified impact metrics
Usage: POST { "query": "What is Prasad's current role and experience with agentic AI?" }
